note: Vermont counties do not tax business personal property; towns do, and each town may exempt business machinery and equipment and inventory separately (32 V.S.A. sections 3848 and 3849). Reports go to the town listers or assessor. Other county-level business duties, such as lodging occupancy taxes, licenses or clerk filings, were not checked.
